_about: The product areas Docloop maps documentation and code onto. This is the closed vocabulary
BLUEPRINT §10.0 calls for: both sides of the doc<->code index are assigned into THIS list,
which is what lets a code change find the articles it affects.
It is deliberately hand-written and deliberately small. An earlier attempt derived area names
automatically from code identifiers and produced things like 'serializer-scrollabletab-
navigation' — meaningless to a writer and useless for matching, because docs are written in
the user's language and code in the implementer's. A closed vocabulary a documentation lead
recognises is the whole mechanism; if a name here would puzzle one of your writers, it is the
EDIT THIS FILE BY HAND. Add an area when a real body of docs has nowhere to sit; merge two
when nothing ever distinguishes them. Then re-run scripts/map-areas.mjs to reassign.
Slugs are stable identifiers — renaming one orphans every mapping that used it.
